direct_inputs.role: style-reference warm handdrawn dark-brown contours and watercolor material
style-reference rounded forms watercolor paper grain; not identity or object anatomy

geometry_scope: Source-sheet cell measurements only. No registration, cropping, alpha cleaning, upscaling, final animation acceptance or catalog adoption performed.
prompt_text:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent RGBA sprite source sheet for small animated background props in a children's counting video. Input image 1 (bear) and input image 2 (red panda) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their warm dark-brown hand-drawn contours, simple rounded forms, warm muted watercolor pigment and subtle paper grain INSIDE the painted shapes. Do not copy any animal, face, ears, paws, tail or hat. No faces, no eyes, no animal parts, no hats, no text, no lettering, no grid lines, no background, no ground, no drop shadow, no decorative extra objects. The space around every object must be genuinely transparent. Keep contours clean and readable at small display size; avoid glossy 3D, hard vector gradients, black outlines, photorealism or wispy semi-transparent outlines.
Primary request: One LARGE SQUARE source sheet, preferably 2048x2048 or at least 1536x1536 native pixels, exactly ONE column and THREE equal rows. Each row contains one full identical upright toy-like rocket, nose upward, with a warm cream body, muted coral-red rounded nose cone and two rounded coral-red fins, a single pale turquoise circular porthole and a small dark warm-brown nozzle. The porthole is a plain window, not an eye. Camera front three-quarter view with the SAME proportions and body orientation in all three rows. Body-only nose-to-nozzle length around 350-400 native pixels if canvas 1536, or 470-520 if canvas 2048, with stable body physical size and exact nozzle reference location across rows; the body reference EXCLUDES exhaust.
Row order TOP to BOTTOM: row1 IDLE with no flame at all; row2 IGNITION with a small warm orange/yellow flame about one-fifth body length; row3 STEADY THRUST with a fuller compact warm orange/yellow plume about one-third body length. Keep the whole rocket, fin tips and whole flame visible with generous transparent margins around every row. Reserve room for flame below the nozzle so it never crosses cell boundaries. No smoke cloud, no sparkles, no stars. Make all three bodies clearly the SAME rocket and same painted geometry. Exactly three rockets.

geometry_observation.caution: Nominal sheet grid is an intent. Inspect actual row bands; equal-third cuts can touch neighboring pixels. Root owns final frame rectangles and stable body/nozzle/rotor registration.

visual_review.method: view_image inspection of original saved output plus alpha measurements
visual_review.style: Warm brown handdrawn contour, rounded inanimate forms and soft watercolor grain; no faces, animal parts, hats, text or scene background.
visual_review.scope: Source-sheet review only, not a final motion loop, alignment acceptance or completed-video review.
